verdict.rationale: Event-driven rule automation is a fair axis for a monitoring platform like Sentry, but the evidence pack never documents user-defined rules or triggers that fire actions on events. The material covers agent tracing dashboards, automatic instrumentation and automatic incident-to-release mapping. Those are built-in behaviors, not configurable rule-to-action automation, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
